"""Focused tests for durable browser-consent restart tickets."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import unittest

from oauthsvc import resume
from oauthsvc.service import OAuthError, OAuthService
from oauthsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class ConsentRestartHttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _authorize(self, server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, state="state-1"):
        status, body = server.post(
            "/oauth/authorize", {"client_id": client_id, "redirect_uri": callback, "state": state}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        return body["login_id"]

    def test_restart_returns_exactly_restart_id_and_pending_client_id(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)

                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read", "devices.list"]},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 201)
                self.assertEqual(set(body.keys()), {"restart_id", "pending_client_id"})
                self.assertIsInstance(body["restart_id"], str)
                self.assertEqual(body["pending_client_id"], CLIENT_ID)

    def test_restart_names_authoritative_owner_per_client(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_a = self._authorize(server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK)
                login_b = self._authorize(
                    server, client_id=OTHER_CLIENT_ID, callback=OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK
                )

                _, body_a = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": login_a, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]}
                )
                _, body_b = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": login_b, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]}
                )

                self.assertEqual(body_a["pending_client_id"], CLIENT_ID)
                self.assertEqual(body_b["pending_client_id"], OTHER_CLIENT_ID)
                self.assertNotEqual(body_a["restart_id"], body_b["restart_id"])

    def test_restart_rejects_unknown_login_id(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": "does-not-exist", "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_login"})

    def test_restart_rejects_already_completed_login(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)
                status, _ = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 200)

                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_authorization"})

    def test_restart_does_not_expose_stored_credentials(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)
                _, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": login_id, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]}
                )
                serialized = str(body)
                self.assertNotIn(ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, serialized)
                self.assertNotIn("password", serialized)
                self.assertNotIn("browser_handle", serialized)
                self.assertNotIn("account_id", serialized)


class ConsentRestartMalformedRequestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post("/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": "x"})
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_extra_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": "x", "approved_scopes": ["a"], "state": "extra"},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_non_string_login_id_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": 104, "approved_scopes": ["a"]}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_non_list_approved_scopes_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": "x", "approved_scopes": "profile.read"}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_approved_scopes_with_non_string_item_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": "x", "approved_scopes": ["profile.read", 1]}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_request_body_that_is_not_an_object_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post_raw("/oauth/consent/restarts", b"[1, 2, 3]")
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})


class ConsentRestartPersistenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_restart_ticket_stores_exact_callback_scopes_state_and_expiry(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", code_ttl_seconds=42)

            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "consent-state-104")
            login_id = authorize_result["login_id"]

            result = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["profile.read", "devices.list"])

            restart = storage.get_consent_restart(result["restart_id"])
            self.assertIsNotNone(restart)
            self.assertEqual(restart.login_id, login_id)
            self.assertEqual(restart.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertIsNone(restart.account_id)
            self.assertEqual(restart.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertEqual(restart.approved_scopes, ["profile.read", "devices.list"])
            self.assertEqual(restart.state, "consent-state-104")
            self.assertTrue(restart.browser_handle)
            self.assertEqual(restart.locator, resume.encode_continuation_locator(restart.browser_handle, CLIENT_ID))
            self.assertGreater(restart.expires_at, 0)

    def test_restart_ticket_survives_a_fresh_storage_handle(self):
        fd, path = __import__("tempfile").mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(path)
        try:
            storage = Storage(path)
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            result = service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], ["profile.read"])
            storage.close()

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                restart = reopened.get_consent_restart(result["restart_id"])
                self.assertIsNotNone(restart)
                self.assertEqual(restart.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
                self.assertEqual(restart.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
                self.assertEqual(restart.approved_scopes, ["profile.read"])
            finally:
                reopened.close()
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.remove(path)

    def test_repeated_restarts_for_same_login_each_persist_independently(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            login_id = authorize_result["login_id"]

            first = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["profile.read"])
            second = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["devices.list"])

            self.assertNotEqual(first["restart_id"], second["restart_id"])
            first_restart = storage.get_consent_restart(first["restart_id"])
            second_restart = storage.get_consent_restart(second["restart_id"])
            self.assertNotEqual(first_restart.browser_handle, second_restart.browser_handle)
            self.assertEqual(first_restart.approved_scopes, ["profile.read"])
            self.assertEqual(second_restart.approved_scopes, ["devices.list"])


class ConsentRestartDuplicateHandleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_duplicate_handle_text_stays_bound_to_its_own_client(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            storage.create_pending_authorization(
                "login-a", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-a", source="native", created_at=0.0
            )
            storage.create_pending_authorization(
                "login-b", OTHER_CLIENT_ID, OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-b", source="native", created_at=0.0
            )

            shared_handle = "consent-ledger:shared-handle"
            locator_a = resume.encode_continuation_locator(shared_handle, CLIENT_ID)
            locator_b = resume.encode_continuation_locator(shared_handle, OTHER_CLIENT_ID)

            storage.create_consent_restart(
                restart_id="restart-a",
                login_id="login-a",
                client_id=CLIENT_ID,
                redirect_uri=CLIENT_CALLBACK,
                approved_scopes=["profile.read"],
                state="state-a",
                browser_handle=shared_handle,
                locator=locator_a,
                created_at=0.0,
                expires_at=100.0,
            )
            storage.create_consent_restart(
                restart_id="restart-b",
                login_id="login-b",
                client_id=OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
                redirect_uri=OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
                approved_scopes=["devices.list"],
                state="state-b",
                browser_handle=shared_handle,
                locator=locator_b,
                created_at=0.0,
                expires_at=100.0,
            )

            restart_a = storage.get_consent_restart("restart-a")
            restart_b = storage.get_consent_restart("restart-b")

            self.assertEqual(restart_a.browser_handle, restart_b.browser_handle)
            self.assertEqual(restart_a.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(restart_b.client_id, OTHER_CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(restart_a.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertEqual(restart_b.redirect_uri, OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK)


class ConsentRestartExactCallbackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_restart_uses_pending_authorization_callback_not_a_recomputed_one(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")

            result = service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], ["profile.read"])
            restart = storage.get_consent_restart(result["restart_id"])

            self.assertEqual(restart.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertNotEqual(restart.redirect_uri, OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK)

    def test_restart_rejected_when_registered_callback_no_longer_matches_pending(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")

            with storage._lock, storage._conn:
                storage._conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE clients SET redirect_uri = ? WHERE client_id = ?",
                    ("http://127.0.0.1:9999/moved", CLIENT_ID),
                )

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], ["profile.read"])
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_authorization")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser
from oauthsvc.service import DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS


class ParserShapeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_create_account_shape(self):
        args = build_parser().parse_args(
            ["create-account", "acct-1", "a@example.com", "hunter2", "--database", "state.db"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(args.command, "create-account")
        self.assertEqual(args.account_id, "acct-1")
        self.assertEqual(args.email, "a@example.com")
        self.assertEqual(args.password, "hunter2")
        self.assertEqual(args.database, "state.db")

    def test_register_client_shape(self):
        args = build_parser().parse_args(
            ["register-client", "client-a", "http://127.0.0.1:4311/callback", "--database", "state.db"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(args.command, "register-client")
        self.assertEqual(args.client_id, "client-a")
        self.assertEqual(args.redirect_uri, "http://127.0.0.1:4311/callback")
        self.assertEqual(args.database, "state.db")

    def test_import_legacy_login_shape(self):
        args = build_parser().parse_args(
            [
                "import-legacy-login",
                "client-a",
                "http://127.0.0.1:4311/callback",
                "consent-ledger:client-b",
                "state-104",
                "--database",
                "state.db",
            ]

    def test_serve_shape_with_default_code_ttl(self):

            ["serve", "--database", "state.db", "--signing-key", "topsecret"]
        )

"""Command-line entry point: python -m oauthsvc.cli ..."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .server import make_server
from .service import DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS, OAuthError, OAuthService
from .storage import Storage


def _positive_int(raw: str) -> int:
    try:
        value = int(raw)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{raw!r} is not an integer") from None
    if value <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be a positive integer")
    return value


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m oauthsvc.cli")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create_account = sub.add_parser("create-account")
    create_account.add_argument("account_id")
    create_account.add_argument("email")
    create_account.add_argument("password")
    create_account.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    register_client = sub.add_parser("register-client")
    register_client.add_argument("client_id")
    register_client.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    register_client.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    import_legacy_login = sub.add_parser("import-legacy-login")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("client_id")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("legacy_handle")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("state")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    serve = sub.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--signing-key", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--code-ttl-seconds", type=_positive_int, default=DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    storage = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        if args.command == "create-account":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.create_account(args.account_id, args.email, args.password)
            return 0

        if args.command == "register-client":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.register_client(args.client_id, args.redirect_uri)
            return 0

        if args.command == "import-legacy-login":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            result = service.import_legacy_login(
                args.client_id, args.redirect_uri, args.legacy_handle, args.state
            )
            print(json.dumps(result))
            return 0

        if args.command == "serve":
            server = make_server(
                storage, args.signing_key, code_ttl_seconds=args.code_ttl_seconds
            )
            host, port = server.server_address[:2]
            print(f"Listening on http://{host}:{port}")
            try:
                server.serve_forever()
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                server.shutdown()
                server.server_close()
            return 0

        raise AssertionError(f"unhandled command {args.command!r}")
    except OAuthError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc.error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        if args.command != "serve":
            storage.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be a positive integer")
    return value


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m oauthsvc.cli")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create_account = sub.add_parser("create-account")
    create_account.add_argument("account_id")

    create_account.add_argument("password")
    create_account.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    register_client = sub.add_parser("register-client")
    register_client.add_argument("client_id")
    register_client.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    register_client.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    import_legacy_login = sub.add_parser("import-legacy-login")

    serve = sub.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--signing-key", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--code-ttl-seconds", type=_positive_int, default=DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS)

    cleanup_consent_restarts = sub.add_parser("cleanup-consent-restarts")

    consent_restart_status = sub.add_parser("consent-restart-status")
    consent_restart_status.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    consent_restart_status.add_argument("--limit", type=_positive_int, default=10)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    storage = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        if args.command == "create-account":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.create_account(args.account_id, args.email, args.password)
            return 0

        if args.command == "register-client":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.register_client(args.client_id, args.redirect_uri)
            return 0

        if args.command == "import-legacy-login":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            result = service.import_legacy_login(
                args.client_id, args.redirect_uri, args.legacy_handle, args.state
            )
            print(json.dumps(result))
            return 0

        if args.command == "serve":
            server = make_server(
                storage, args.signing_key, code_ttl_seconds=args.code_ttl_seconds
            )
            host, port = server.server_address[:2]
            print(f"Listening on http://{host}:{port}")
            try:
                server.serve_forever()
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                server.shutdown()
                server.server_close()
            return 0

        raise AssertionError(f"unhandled command {args.command!r}")
    except OAuthError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc.error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        if args.command != "serve":
            storage.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Focused tests for single-use authorization codes (replay rejection)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc.service import OAuthError, OAuthService

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class ServiceLevelReplayTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_second_exchange_of_same_code_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            location = service.complete_login(authorize_result["login_id"], ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]

            first = service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertIn("access_token", first)

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_code")

    def test_replay_after_wrong_client_attempt_still_lets_owner_redeem_once(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            location = service.complete_login(authorize_result["login_id"], ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]

            from .helpers import OTHER_CLIENT_ID

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.exchange_token(OTHER_CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "wrong_client")

            # A wrong-client attempt must not consume the code.
            first = service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertIn("access_token", first)

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_code")


class HttpLevelReplayTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_replayed_code_returns_invalid_code_over_http(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                _, authorize_body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize",
                    {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state": "state-1"},
                )
                _, complete_body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {
                        "login_id": authorize_body["login_id"],
                        "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID,
                        "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
                    },
                )
                code = parse_qs(urlsplit(complete_body["location"]).query)["code"][0]

                first_status, _ = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                self.assertEqual(first_status, 200)

                status, body = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_code"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Focused tests for restart-ticket expiry cleanup and consent denial history."""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc import resume
from oauthsvc.cli import main
from oauthsvc.service import OAuthService
from oauthsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_EMAIL,
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start: float = 1_000.0):
        self._now = start

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self._now

    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self._now += seconds


def _seed_restart(storage, restart_id, expires_at, login_id="login-1", client_id=CLIENT_ID,
                   callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, approved_scopes=None):
    storage.create_pending_authorization(
        login_id, client_id, callback, "state-1", source="native", created_at=0.0
    )
    browser_handle = f"handle-{restart_id}"
    locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(browser_handle, client_id)
    storage.create_consent_restart(
        restart_id=restart_id,
        login_id=login_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        redirect_uri=callback,
        approved_scopes=approved_scopes or ["profile.read"],
        state="state-1",
        browser_handle=browser_handle,
        locator=locator,
        created_at=0.0,
        expires_at=expires_at,
    )


@contextlib.contextmanager
def temp_db_path():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
    os.close(fd)
    os.remove(path)
    try:
        yield path
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)


def _run_cli(argv):
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        code = main(argv)
    return code, buf.getvalue()


class CleanupBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ticket_exactly_at_expiry_boundary_is_not_removed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-boundary", expires_at=clock())
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(removed, 0)
            self.assertIsNotNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-boundary"))

    def test_ticket_past_expiry_is_removed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 0.001)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)
            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))

    def test_cleanup_only_removes_expired_leaving_active_ticket_intact(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 10, login_id="login-a")
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-active", expires_at=clock() + 10, login_id="login-b")
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)
            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))
            self.assertIsNotNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-active"))


class RepeatedCleanupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_repeated_cleanup_in_same_process_is_idempotent(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            first = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            second = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            third = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(first, 1)
            self.assertEqual(second, 0)
            self.assertEqual(third, 0)


class CleanupAcrossProcessRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_idempotent_after_reopening_storage(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            storage = Storage(path)
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)
            first = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            storage.close()

            self.assertEqual(first, 1)

            # Simulate a process restart: brand-new Storage handle, same file.
            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                reopened_service = OAuthService(reopened, signing_key="k", clock=clock)
                second = reopened_service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
                self.assertEqual(second, 0)
                self.assertIsNone(reopened.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))
            finally:
                reopened.close()


class CleanupPreservesOtherRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_preserves_active_pending_authorization_and_used_code(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            # An active (uncompleted) pending authorization, unrelated to the expired ticket.
            active_login = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-active")["login_id"]

            # A fully redeemed (used) authorization code.
            code_login = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-code")["login_id"]
            location = service.complete_login(code_login, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]
            service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)

            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5, login_id="restart-login")

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)

            active_pending = storage.get_pending_authorization(active_login)
            self.assertIsNotNone(active_pending)
            self.assertFalse(active_pending.completed)

            used_code = storage.get_code(code)
            self.assertIsNotNone(used_code)
            self.assertTrue(used_code.used)

            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))


class ConsentDenialHistoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _authorize_and_restart(self, service, scopes):
        login_id = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")["login_id"]
        return service.create_consent_restart(login_id, scopes)["restart_id"]

    def test_denied_decision_records_denial_history_and_issues_no_code(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id = self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            location = service.complete_consent_restart(
                restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", []
            )

            query = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)
            self.assertEqual(query["error"], ["access_denied"])
            self.assertNotIn("code", query)

            denials = storage.list_recent_consent_denials(limit=10)
            self.assertEqual(len(denials), 1)
            self.assertEqual(denials[0].restart_id, restart_id)
            self.assertEqual(denials[0].client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(denials[0].account_id, ACCOUNT_ID)

    def test_approved_decision_does_not_record_denial(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id = self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            service.complete_consent_restart(
                restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "approved", ["profile.read"]
            )

            self.assertEqual(storage.list_recent_consent_denials(limit=10), [])

    def test_status_reports_bounded_recent_denials_most_recent_first(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            restart_ids = [self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"]) for _ in range(3)]
            for restart_id in restart_ids:
                service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

            status = service.consent_restart_status(limit=2)

            self.assertEqual(len(status["recent_denials"]), 2)
            reported_ids = [entry["restart_id"] for entry in status["recent_denials"]]
            self.assertEqual(reported_ids, list(reversed(restart_ids))[:2])


class CliCleanupAndStatusTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_consent_restarts_parser_shape(self):
        from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser

        args = build_parser().parse_args(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", "state.db"])
        self.assertEqual(args.command, "cleanup-consent-restarts")
        self.assertEqual(args.database, "state.db")

    def test_consent_restart_status_parser_shape_with_default_limit(self):
        from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser

        args = build_parser().parse_args(["consent-restart-status", "--database", "state.db"])
        self.assertEqual(args.command, "consent-restart-status")
        self.assertEqual(args.database, "state.db")
        self.assertEqual(args.limit, 10)

    def test_consent_restart_status_rejects_non_positive_limit(self):
        from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser

        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            build_parser().parse_args(
                ["consent-restart-status", "--database", "state.db", "--limit", "0"]
            )

    def test_cli_cleanup_end_to_end_is_idempotent_across_invocations(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            exit_code, _ = _run_cli(
                ["create-account", ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_EMAIL, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "--database", path]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            exit_code, _ = _run_cli(
                ["register-client", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "--database", path]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)

            storage = Storage(path)
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=-1.0)
            storage.close()

            exit_code, out = _run_cli(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", path])
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), {"removed": 1})

            # A second CLI invocation is a brand-new process/Storage handle.
            exit_code, out = _run_cli(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", path])
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), {"removed": 0})

    def test_cli_status_reports_bounded_counts_and_denials(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            _run_cli(["create-account", ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_EMAIL, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "--database", path])
            _run_cli(["register-client", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "--database", path])

            storage = Storage(path)
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-active", expires_at=1e18, login_id="login-active")
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=-1.0, login_id="login-expired")
            for i in range(3):
                storage.record_consent_denial(f"restart-denied-{i}", CLIENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, "state-1", float(i))
            storage.close()

            exit_code, out = _run_cli(
                ["consent-restart-status", "--database", path, "--limit", "2"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            status = json.loads(out)
            self.assertEqual(status["active_consent_restarts"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(status["expired_consent_restarts"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(status["recent_denials"]), 2)


class SeparateProcessReadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_second_storage_handle_sees_cleanup_and_denial_results(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            process_a = Storage(path)
            try:
                seed(process_a)
                clock = FakeClock()
                service_a = OAuthService(process_a, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

                restart_id = service_a.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")["login_id"]
                restart_id = service_a.create_consent_restart(restart_id, ["profile.read"])["restart_id"]
                service_a.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

                _seed_restart(process_a, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 1, login_id="other-login")
                removed = service_a.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
                self.assertEqual(removed, 1)
            finally:
                process_a.close()

            process_b = Storage(path)
            try:
                self.assertIsNone(process_b.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))
                self.assertEqual(process_b.count_expired_consent_restarts(now=clock()), 0)

                denials = process_b.list_recent_consent_denials(limit=10)
                self.assertEqual(len(denials), 1)
                self.assertEqual(denials[0].restart_id, restart_id)
                self.assertEqual(denials[0].account_id, ACCOUNT_ID)
            finally:
                process_b.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self._now += seconds


def _seed_restart(storage, restart_id, expires_at, login_id="login-1", client_id=CLIENT_ID,
                   callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, approved_scopes=None):
    storage.create_pending_authorization(
        login_id, client_id, callback, "state-1", source="native", created_at=0.0
    )
    browser_handle = f"handle-{restart_id}"
    locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(browser_handle, client_id)
    storage.create_consent_restart(
        restart_id=restart_id,
        login_id=login_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        redirect_uri=callback,
        approved_scopes=approved_scopes or ["profile.read"],
        state="state-1",
        browser_handle=browser_handle,
        locator=locator,
        created_at=0.0,
        expires_at=expires_at,
    )


@contextlib.contextmanager
def temp_db_path():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
    os.close(fd)
    os.remove(path)
    try:
        yield path
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)


def _run_cli(argv):
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        code = main(argv)
    return code, buf.getvalue()

class CleanupAcrossProcessRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):

class CleanupPreservesOtherRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_preserves_active_pending_authorization_and_used_code(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            # An active (uncompleted) pending authorization, unrelated to the expired ticket.
            active_login = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-active")["login_id"]

            # A fully redeemed (used) authorization code.
            code_login = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-code")["login_id"]
            location = service.complete_login(code_login, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]
            service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)

            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5, login_id="restart-login")

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)

            active_pending = storage.get_pending_authorization(active_login)
            self.assertIsNotNone(active_pending)
            self.assertFalse(active_pending.completed)

            used_code = storage.get_code(code)
            self.assertIsNotNone(used_code)
            self.assertTrue(used_code.used)

            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))


class ConsentDenialHistoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _authorize_and_restart(self, service, scopes):

        return service.create_consent_restart(login_id, scopes)["restart_id"]

    def test_denied_decision_records_denial_history_and_issues_no_code(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)

            restart_id = self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            location = service.complete_consent_restart(
                restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", []
            )

            query = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)

            denials = storage.list_recent_consent_denials(limit=10)

            self.assertEqual(denials[0].client_id, CLIENT_ID)

            )

                ["consent-restart-status", "--database", "state.db", "--limit", "0"]

    def test_cli_cleanup_end_to_end_is_idempotent_across_invocations(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            exit_code, _ = _run_cli(
                ["create-account", ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_EMAIL, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "--database", path]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            exit_code, _ = _run_cli(
                ["register-client", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "--database", path]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)

            storage = Storage(path)
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=-1.0)
            storage.close()

            exit_code, out = _run_cli(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", path])
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), {"removed": 1})

            # A second CLI invocation is a brand-new process/Storage handle.
            exit_code, out = _run_cli(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", path])
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), {"removed": 0})

            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=-1.0, login_id="login-expired")
            for i in range(3):

            status = json.loads(out)

            self.assertEqual(status["expired_consent_restarts"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(status["recent_denials"]), 2)

"""Focused tests for single-use authorization codes (replay rejection)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc.service import OAuthError, OAuthService

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class ServiceLevelReplayTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_second_exchange_of_same_code_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            location = service.complete_login(authorize_result["login_id"], ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]

            first = service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertIn("access_token", first)

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_code")

    def test_replay_after_wrong_client_attempt_still_lets_owner_redeem_once(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            location = service.complete_login(authorize_result["login_id"], ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]

            from .helpers import OTHER_CLIENT_ID

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.exchange_token(OTHER_CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "wrong_client")

            # A wrong-client attempt must not consume the code.
            first = service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertIn("access_token", first)

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_code")


class HttpLevelReplayTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_replayed_code_returns_invalid_code_over_http(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                _, authorize_body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize",
                    {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state": "state-1"},
                )
                _, complete_body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {
                        "login_id": authorize_body["login_id"],
                        "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID,
                        "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
                    },
                )
                code = parse_qs(urlsplit(complete_body["location"]).query)["code"][0]

                first_status, _ = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                self.assertEqual(first_status, 200)

                status, body = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_code"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Command-line entry point: python -m oauthsvc.cli ..."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .server import make_server
from .service import DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS, OAuthError, OAuthService
from .storage import Storage


def _positive_int(raw: str) -> int:
    try:
        value = int(raw)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{raw!r} is not an integer") from None
    if value <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be a positive integer")
    return value


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m oauthsvc.cli")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create_account = sub.add_parser("create-account")
    create_account.add_argument("account_id")
    create_account.add_argument("email")
    create_account.add_argument("password")
    create_account.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    register_client = sub.add_parser("register-client")
    register_client.add_argument("client_id")
    register_client.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    register_client.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    import_legacy_login = sub.add_parser("import-legacy-login")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("client_id")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("legacy_handle")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("state")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    serve = sub.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--signing-key", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--code-ttl-seconds", type=_positive_int, default=DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS)

    cleanup_consent_restarts = sub.add_parser("cleanup-consent-restarts")
    cleanup_consent_restarts.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    consent_restart_status = sub.add_parser("consent-restart-status")
    consent_restart_status.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    consent_restart_status.add_argument("--limit", type=_positive_int, default=10)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    storage = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        if args.command == "create-account":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.create_account(args.account_id, args.email, args.password)
            return 0

        if args.command == "register-client":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.register_client(args.client_id, args.redirect_uri)
            return 0

        if args.command == "import-legacy-login":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            result = service.import_legacy_login(
                args.client_id, args.redirect_uri, args.legacy_handle, args.state
            )
            print(json.dumps(result))
            return 0

        if args.command == "cleanup-consent-restarts":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            print(json.dumps({"removed": removed}))
            return 0

        if args.command == "consent-restart-status":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            status = service.consent_restart_status(limit=args.limit)
            print(json.dumps(status))
            return 0

        if args.command == "serve":
            server = make_server(
                storage, args.signing_key, code_ttl_seconds=args.code_ttl_seconds
            )
            host, port = server.server_address[:2]
            print(f"Listening on http://{host}:{port}")
            try:
                server.serve_forever()
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                server.shutdown()
                server.server_close()
            return 0

        raise AssertionError(f"unhandled command {args.command!r}")
    except OAuthError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc.error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        if args.command != "serve":
            storage.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. """SQLite-backed durable storage for accounts, clients, and the login flow."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass


class AlreadyExists(Exception):
    """Raised when a create-account or register-client call collides."""


_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
    account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    password_salt TEXT NOT NULL,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clients (
    client_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pending_authorizations (
    login_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS continuations (
    login_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    locator TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consents (
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    granted_at REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, client_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_codes (
    code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    scopes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
    used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tokens (
    access_token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    code TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consent_restarts (
    restart_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    login_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT,
    redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    approved_scopes TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    browser_handle TEXT NOT NULL,
    locator TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    expires_at REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consent_denials (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    restart_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    denied_at REAL NOT NULL
);
"""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Account:
    account_id: str
    email: str
    password_salt: str
    password_hash: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Client:
    client_id: str
    redirect_uri: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PendingAuthorization:
    login_id: str
    client_id: str
    redirect_uri: str
    state: str
    source: str
    completed: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AuthorizationCode:
    code: str
    client_id: str
    account_id: str
    redirect_uri: str
    state: str
    scopes: list[str]
    expires_at: float
    used: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ConsentRestart:
    restart_id: str
    login_id: str
    client_id: str
    account_id: str | None
    redirect_uri: str
    approved_scopes: list[str]
    state: str
    browser_handle: str
    locator: str
    expires_at: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ConsentDenial:
    restart_id: str
    client_id: str
    account_id: str
    state: str
    denied_at: float


class Storage:
    """Owns the on-disk SQLite database for one service instance."""

    def __init__(self, database_path: str):
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, check_same_thread=False)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()

    # -- accounts ---------------------------------------------------

    def create_account(
        self, account_id: str, email: str, password_salt: str, password_hash: str, created_at: float
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            try:
                with self._conn:
                    self._conn.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO accounts (account_id, email, password_salt, password_hash, created_at)"
                        " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (account_id, email, password_salt, password_hash, created_at),
                    )
            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
                raise AlreadyExists(f"account {account_id!r} already exists") from exc

    def get_account(self, account_id: str) -> Account | None:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id, email, password_salt, password_hash FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?",
                (account_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return Account(row["account_id"], row["email"], row["password_salt"], row["password_hash"])

    # -- clients ------------------------------------------------------

    def register_client(self, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str, created_at: float) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            try:
                with self._conn:
                    self._conn.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO clients (client_id, redirect_uri, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                        (client_id, redirect_uri, created_at),
                    )
            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
                raise AlreadyExists(f"client {client_id!r} already exists") from exc

    def get_client_redirect_uri(self, client_id: str) -> str | None:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT redirect_uri FROM clients WHERE client_id = ?", (client_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        return row["redirect_uri"] if row is not None else None

    # -- pending authorizations ---------------------------------------

    def create_pending_authorization(
        self,
        login_id: str,
        client_id: str,
        redirect_uri: str,
        state: str,
        source: str,
        created_at: float,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO pending_authorizations"
                " (login_id, client_id, redirect_uri, state, source, completed, created_at)"
                " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?)",
                (login_id, client_id, redirect_uri, state, source, created_at),
            )

    def get_pending_authorization(self, login_id: str) -> PendingAuthorization | None:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT login_id, client_id, redirect_uri, state, source, completed"
                " FROM pending_authorizations WHERE login_id = ?",
                (login_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return PendingAuthorization(
            row["login_id"],
            row["client_id"],
            row["redirect_uri"],
            row["state"],
            row["source"],
            bool(row["completed"]),
        )

    def mark_pending_authorization_completed(self, login_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE pending_authorizations SET completed = 1 WHERE login_id = ?", (login_id,)
            )

    # -- continuations --------------------------------------------------

    def save_continuation(self, login_id: str, client_id: str, locator: str, created_at: float) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO continuations (login_id, client_id, locator, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (login_id, client_id, locator, created_at),
            )

    def get_continuation(self, login_id: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT client_id, locator FROM continuations WHERE login_id = ?", (login_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return row["client_id"], row["locator"]

    # -- consents -------------------------------------------------------

    def record_consent(self, account_id: str, client_id: str, granted_at: float) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO consents (account_id, client_id, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)"
                " ON CONFLICT (account_id, client_id) DO UPDATE SET granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
                (account_id, client_id, granted_at),
            )

    # -- authorization codes ---------------------------------------------

    def create_code(
        self,
        code: str,
        client_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        redirect_uri: str,
        state: str,
        created_at: float,
        expires_at: float,
        scopes: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO authorization_codes"
                " (code, client_id, account_id, redirect_uri, state, scopes, created_at, expires_at, used)"
                " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)",
                (code, client_id, account_id, redirect_uri, state, json.dumps(scopes or []), created_at, expires_at),
            )

    def get_code(self, code: str) -> AuthorizationCode | None:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT code, client_id, account_id, redirect_uri, state, scopes, expires_at, used"
                " FROM authorization_codes WHERE code = ?",
                (code,),
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return AuthorizationCode(
            row["code"],
            row["client_id"],
            row["account_id"],
            row["redirect_uri"],
            row["state"],
            json.loads(row["scopes"]),
            row["expires_at"],
            bool(row["used"]),
        )

    def mark_code_used(self, code: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute("UPDATE authorization_codes SET used = 1 WHERE code = ?", (code,))

    # -- tokens -----------------------------------------------------------

    def create_token(
        self, access_token: str, client_id: str, account_id: str, code: str, created_at: float
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO tokens (access_token, client_id, account_id, code, created_at)"
                " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (access_token, client_id, account_id, code, created_at),
            )

    # -- consent restarts ---------------------------------------------------

    def create_consent_restart(
        self,
        restart_id: str,
        login_id: str,
        client_id: str,
        redirect_uri: str,
        approved_scopes: list[str],
        state: str,
        browser_handle: str,
        locator: str,
        created_at: float,
        expires_at: float,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO consent_restarts"
                " (restart_id, login_id, client_id, account_id, redirect_uri, approved_scopes,"
                "  state, browser_handle, locator, created_at, expires_at)"
                " VALUES (?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    restart_id,
                    login_id,
                    client_id,
                    redirect_uri,
                    json.dumps(approved_scopes),
                    state,
                    browser_handle,
                    locator,
                    created_at,
                    expires_at,
                ),
            )

    def get_consent_restart(self, restart_id: str) -> ConsentRestart | None:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT restart_id, login_id, client_id, account_id, redirect_uri,"
                "       approved_scopes, state, browser_handle, locator, expires_at"
                " FROM consent_restarts WHERE restart_id = ?",
                (restart_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return ConsentRestart(
            row["restart_id"],
            row["login_id"],
            row["client_id"],
            row["account_id"],
            row["redirect_uri"],
            json.loads(row["approved_scopes"]),
            row["state"],
            row["browser_handle"],
            row["locator"],
            row["expires_at"],
        )

    def cleanup_expired_consent_restarts(self, now: float) -> int:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cursor = self._conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM consent_restarts WHERE expires_at < ?", (now,)
            )
            return cursor.rowcount

    def count_active_consent_restarts(self, now: float) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM consent_restarts WHERE expires_at >= ?", (now,)
            ).fetchone()
        return row["n"]

    def count_expired_consent_restarts(self, now: float) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM consent_restarts WHERE expires_at < ?", (now,)
            ).fetchone()
        return row["n"]

    # -- consent denial history ----------------------------------------------

    def record_consent_denial(
        self, restart_id: str, client_id: str, account_id: str, state: str, denied_at: float
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO consent_denials (restart_id, client_id, account_id, state, denied_at)"
                " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (restart_id, client_id, account_id, state, denied_at),
            )

    def list_recent_consent_denials(self, limit: int) -> list[ConsentDenial]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT restart_id, client_id, account_id, state, denied_at"
                " FROM consent_denials ORDER BY denied_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?",
                (limit,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [
            ConsentDenial(row["restart_id"], row["client_id"], row["account_id"], row["state"], row["denied_at"])
            for row in rows
        ]

1	"""Core authorization-code business logic, shared by the CLI and HTTP service."""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import time
5	from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode, urlsplit, urlunsplit
6	
7	from . import resume, security
8	from .storage import AlreadyExists, Storage
9	
10	DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS = 120
11	
12	
13	class OAuthError(Exception):
14	    """Carries one of the documented error codes for the HTTP/CLI surfaces."""
15	
16	    def __init__(self, error: str):
17	        super().__init__(error)
18	        self.error = error
19	
20	
21	class OAuthService:
22	    def __init__(
23	        self,
24	        storage: Storage,
25	        signing_key: str,
26	        code_ttl_seconds: int = DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS,
27	        clock=time.time,
28	    ):
29	        self._storage = storage
30	        self._signing_key = signing_key
31	        self._code_ttl_seconds = code_ttl_seconds
32	        self._clock = clock
33	
34	    # -- account / client provisioning -----------------------------------
35	
36	    def create_account(self, account_id: str, email: str, password: str) -> None:
37	        salt, digest = security.hash_password(password)
38	        try:
39	            self._storage.create_account(account_id, email, salt, digest, self._clock())
40	        except AlreadyExists as exc:
41	            raise OAuthError("account_exists") from exc
42	
43	    def register_client(self, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str) -> None:
44	        try:
45	            self._storage.register_client(client_id, redirect_uri, self._clock())
46	        except AlreadyExists as exc:
47	            raise OAuthError("client_exists") from exc
48	
49	    # -- authorization start -----------------------------------------------
50	
51	    def authorize(self, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str, state: str) -> dict:
52	        self._require_registered_callback(client_id, redirect_uri)
53	        login_id = security.new_login_id()
54	        now = self._clock()
55	        self._storage.create_pending_authorization(
56	            login_id, client_id, redirect_uri, state, source="native", created_at=now
57	        )
58	        locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(login_id, client_id)
59	        self._storage.save_continuation(login_id, client_id, locator, now)
60	        return {
61	            "login_id": login_id,
62	            "resume_reference": {"kind": "native", "client_id": client_id, "value": locator},
63	        }
64	
65	    def import_legacy_login(
66	        self, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str, legacy_handle: str, state: str
67	    ) -> dict:
68	        self._require_registered_callback(client_id, redirect_uri)
69	        login_id = security.new_login_id()
70	        now = self._clock()
71	        self._storage.create_pending_authorization(
72	            login_id, client_id, redirect_uri, state, source="imported", created_at=now
73	        )
74	        locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(legacy_handle, client_id)
75	        self._storage.save_continuation(login_id, client_id, locator, now)
76	        return {
77	            "client_id": client_id,
78	            "login_id": login_id,
79	            "resume_reference": {"kind": "imported", "client_id": client_id, "value": locator},
80	        }
81	
82	    def _require_registered_callback(self, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str) -> None:
83	        registered = self._storage.get_client_redirect_uri(client_id)
84	        if registered is None or registered != redirect_uri:
85	            raise OAuthError("unregistered_callback")
86	
87	    # -- login completion ----------------------------------------------------
88	
89	    def complete_login(self, login_id: str, account_id: str, password: str) -> str:
90	        pending = self._storage.get_pending_authorization(login_id)
91	        if pending is None:
92	            raise OAuthError("invalid_login")
93	
94	        account = self._storage.get_account(account_id)
95	        if account is None or not security.verify_password(
96	            password, account.password_salt, account.password_hash
97	        ):
98	            raise OAuthError("invalid_credentials")
99	
100	        continuation = self._storage.get_continuation(login_id)
101	        if continuation is None:
102	            raise OAuthError("invalid_continuation")
103	        _saved_client_id, locator = continuation
104	
105	        def callback_for_client(client_id: str) -> str | None:
106	            return self._storage.get_client_redirect_uri(client_id)
107	
108	        client_id, callback = resume.recover_client_and_callback(
109	            locator, pending.client_id, callback_for_client
110	        )
111	        if callback is None:
112	            raise OAuthError("invalid_continuation")
113	
114	        if pending.completed or client_id != pending.client_id or callback != pending.redirect_uri:
115	            raise OAuthError("invalid_authorization")
116	
117	        now = self._clock()
118	        self._storage.mark_pending_authorization_completed(login_id)
119	        self._storage.record_consent(account_id, client_id, now)
120	
121	        code = security.new_authorization_code()
122	        expires_at = now + self._code_ttl_seconds
123	        self._storage.create_code(
124	            code, client_id, account_id, pending.redirect_uri, pending.state, now, expires_at
125	        )
126	
127	        return _append_query(callback, {"code": code, "state": pending.state})
128	
129	    # -- consent restart tickets ---------------------------------------------
130	
131	    def create_consent_restart(self, login_id: str, approved_scopes: list[str]) -> dict:
132	        pending = self._storage.get_pending_authorization(login_id)
133	        if pending is None:
134	            raise OAuthError("invalid_login")
135	
136	        continuation = self._storage.get_continuation(login_id)
137	        if continuation is None:
138	            raise OAuthError("invalid_continuation")
139	        _saved_client_id, locator_for_login = continuation
140	
141	        def callback_for_client(client_id: str) -> str | None:
142	            return self._storage.get_client_redirect_uri(client_id)
143	
144	        client_id, callback = resume.recover_client_and_callback(
145	            locator_for_login, pending.client_id, callback_for_client
146	        )
147	        if callback is None:
148	            raise OAuthError("invalid_continuation")
149	
150	        if pending.completed or client_id != pending.client_id or callback != pending.redirect_uri:
151	            raise OAuthError("invalid_authorization")
152	
153	        browser_handle = security.new_browser_handle()
154	        locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(browser_handle, pending.client_id)
155	        restart_id = security.new_restart_id()
156	        now = self._clock()
157	        self._storage.create_consent_restart(
158	            restart_id=restart_id,
159	            login_id=login_id,
160	            client_id=pending.client_id,
161	            redirect_uri=pending.redirect_uri,
162	            approved_scopes=approved_scopes,
163	            state=pending.state,
164	            browser_handle=browser_handle,
165	            locator=locator,
166	            created_at=now,
167	            expires_at=now + self._code_ttl_seconds,
168	        )
169	
170	        return {"restart_id": restart_id, "pending_client_id": pending.client_id}
171	
172	    def complete_consent_restart(
173	        self,
174	        restart_id: str,
175	        account_id: str,
176	        password: str,
177	        decision: str,
178	        confirmed_scopes: list[str],
179	    ) -> str:
180	        restart = self._storage.get_consent_restart(restart_id)
181	        if restart is None:
182	            raise OAuthError("invalid_restart")
183	
184	        now = self._clock()
185	        if now > restart.expires_at:
186	            raise OAuthError("expired_restart")
187	
188	        if not set(confirmed_scopes) <= set(restart.approved_scopes):
189	            raise OAuthError("unknown_scope")
190	
191	        account = self._storage.get_account(account_id)
192	        if account is None or not security.verify_password(
193	            password, account.password_salt, account.password_hash
194	        ):
195	            raise OAuthError("invalid_credentials")
196	
197	        # The ticket's own client/callback are authoritative regardless of
198	        # which scopes end up confirmed.
199	        client_id = restart.client_id
200	        callback = restart.redirect_uri
201	
202	        if decision == "denied":
203	            self._storage.record_consent_denial(restart_id, client_id, account_id, restart.state, now)
204	            return _append_query(callback, {"error": "access_denied", "state": restart.state})
205	
206	        self._storage.record_consent(account_id, client_id, now)
207	        code = security.new_authorization_code()
208	        expires_at = now + self._code_ttl_seconds
209	        self._storage.create_code(
210	            code, client_id, account_id, callback, restart.state, now, expires_at, scopes=confirmed_scopes
211	        )
212	        return _append_query(callback, {"code": code, "state": restart.state})
213	
214	    # -- restart-ticket maintenance -------------------------------------------
215	
216	    def cleanup_expired_consent_restarts(self) -> int:
217	        return self._storage.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts(self._clock())
218	
219	    def consent_restart_status(self, limit: int = 10) -> dict:
220	        now = self._clock()
221	        return {
222	            "active_consent_restarts": self._storage.count_active_consent_restarts(now),
223	            "expired_consent_restarts": self._storage.count_expired_consent_restarts(now),
224	            "recent_denials": [
225	                {
226	                    "restart_id": denial.restart_id,
227	                    "client_id": denial.client_id,
228	                    "account_id": denial.account_id,
229	                    "state": denial.state,
230	                    "denied_at": denial.denied_at,
231	                }
232	                for denial in self._storage.list_recent_consent_denials(limit)
233	            ],
234	        }
235	
236	    # -- token exchange -----------------------------------------------------
237	
238	    def exchange_token(self, client_id: str, code: str) -> dict:
239	        row = self._storage.get_code(code)
240	        if row is None or row.used or self._clock() > row.expires_at:
241	            raise OAuthError("invalid_code")
242	        if row.client_id != client_id:
243	            raise OAuthError("wrong_client")
244	
245	        self._storage.mark_code_used(code)
246	        now = self._clock()
247	        access_token = security.new_access_token(self._signing_key, client_id, row.account_id, code)
248	        self._storage.create_token(access_token, client_id, row.account_id, code, now)
249	        return {"access_token": access_token, "client_id": client_id, "account_id": row.account_id}
250	
251	
252	def _append_query(url: str, extra: dict) -> str:
253	    parts = urlsplit(url)
254	    query = parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True)
255	    query.extend(extra.items())
256	    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, urlencode(query), parts.fragment))
