"""Focused tests for durable browser-consent restart tickets."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import unittest

from oauthsvc import resume
from oauthsvc.service import OAuthError, OAuthService
from oauthsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class ConsentRestartHttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _authorize(self, server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, state="state-1"):
        status, body = server.post(
            "/oauth/authorize", {"client_id": client_id, "redirect_uri": callback, "state": state}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        return body["login_id"]

    def test_restart_returns_exactly_restart_id_and_pending_client_id(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)

                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read", "devices.list"]},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 201)
                self.assertEqual(set(body.keys()), {"restart_id", "pending_client_id"})
                self.assertIsInstance(body["restart_id"], str)
                self.assertEqual(body["pending_client_id"], CLIENT_ID)

    def test_restart_names_authoritative_owner_per_client(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_a = self._authorize(server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK)
                login_b = self._authorize(
                    server, client_id=OTHER_CLIENT_ID, callback=OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK
                )

                _, body_a = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": login_a, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]}
                )
                _, body_b = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": login_b, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]}
                )

                self.assertEqual(body_a["pending_client_id"], CLIENT_ID)
                self.assertEqual(body_b["pending_client_id"], OTHER_CLIENT_ID)
                self.assertNotEqual(body_a["restart_id"], body_b["restart_id"])

    def test_restart_rejects_unknown_login_id(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": "does-not-exist", "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_login"})

    def test_restart_rejects_already_completed_login(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)
                status, _ = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 200)

                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_authorization"})

    def test_restart_does_not_expose_stored_credentials(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)
                _, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": login_id, "approved_scopes": ["profile.read"]}
                )
                serialized = str(body)
                self.assertNotIn(ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, serialized)
                self.assertNotIn("password", serialized)
                self.assertNotIn("browser_handle", serialized)
                self.assertNotIn("account_id", serialized)


class ConsentRestartMalformedRequestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post("/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": "x"})
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_extra_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts",
                    {"login_id": "x", "approved_scopes": ["a"], "state": "extra"},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_non_string_login_id_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": 104, "approved_scopes": ["a"]}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_non_list_approved_scopes_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": "x", "approved_scopes": "profile.read"}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_approved_scopes_with_non_string_item_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts", {"login_id": "x", "approved_scopes": ["profile.read", 1]}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_request_body_that_is_not_an_object_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post_raw("/oauth/consent/restarts", b"[1, 2, 3]")
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})


class ConsentRestartPersistenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_restart_ticket_stores_exact_callback_scopes_state_and_expiry(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", code_ttl_seconds=42)

            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "consent-state-104")
            login_id = authorize_result["login_id"]

            result = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["profile.read", "devices.list"])

            restart = storage.get_consent_restart(result["restart_id"])
            self.assertIsNotNone(restart)
            self.assertEqual(restart.login_id, login_id)
            self.assertEqual(restart.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertIsNone(restart.account_id)
            self.assertEqual(restart.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertEqual(restart.approved_scopes, ["profile.read", "devices.list"])
            self.assertEqual(restart.state, "consent-state-104")
            self.assertTrue(restart.browser_handle)
            self.assertEqual(restart.locator, resume.encode_continuation_locator(restart.browser_handle, CLIENT_ID))
            self.assertGreater(restart.expires_at, 0)

    def test_restart_ticket_survives_a_fresh_storage_handle(self):
        fd, path = __import__("tempfile").mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(path)
        try:
            storage = Storage(path)
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            result = service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], ["profile.read"])
            storage.close()

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                restart = reopened.get_consent_restart(result["restart_id"])
                self.assertIsNotNone(restart)
                self.assertEqual(restart.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
                self.assertEqual(restart.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
                self.assertEqual(restart.approved_scopes, ["profile.read"])
            finally:
                reopened.close()
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.remove(path)

    def test_repeated_restarts_for_same_login_each_persist_independently(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")
            login_id = authorize_result["login_id"]

            first = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["profile.read"])
            second = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["devices.list"])

            self.assertNotEqual(first["restart_id"], second["restart_id"])
            first_restart = storage.get_consent_restart(first["restart_id"])
            second_restart = storage.get_consent_restart(second["restart_id"])
            self.assertNotEqual(first_restart.browser_handle, second_restart.browser_handle)
            self.assertEqual(first_restart.approved_scopes, ["profile.read"])
            self.assertEqual(second_restart.approved_scopes, ["devices.list"])


class ConsentRestartDuplicateHandleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_duplicate_handle_text_stays_bound_to_its_own_client(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            storage.create_pending_authorization(
                "login-a", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-a", source="native", created_at=0.0
            )
            storage.create_pending_authorization(
                "login-b", OTHER_CLIENT_ID, OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-b", source="native", created_at=0.0
            )

            shared_handle = "consent-ledger:shared-handle"
            locator_a = resume.encode_continuation_locator(shared_handle, CLIENT_ID)
            locator_b = resume.encode_continuation_locator(shared_handle, OTHER_CLIENT_ID)

            storage.create_consent_restart(
                restart_id="restart-a",
                login_id="login-a",
                client_id=CLIENT_ID,
                redirect_uri=CLIENT_CALLBACK,
                approved_scopes=["profile.read"],
                state="state-a",
                browser_handle=shared_handle,
                locator=locator_a,
                created_at=0.0,
                expires_at=100.0,
            )
            storage.create_consent_restart(
                restart_id="restart-b",
                login_id="login-b",
                client_id=OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
                redirect_uri=OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
                approved_scopes=["devices.list"],
                state="state-b",
                browser_handle=shared_handle,
                locator=locator_b,
                created_at=0.0,
                expires_at=100.0,
            )

            restart_a = storage.get_consent_restart("restart-a")
            restart_b = storage.get_consent_restart("restart-b")

            self.assertEqual(restart_a.browser_handle, restart_b.browser_handle)
            self.assertEqual(restart_a.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(restart_b.client_id, OTHER_CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(restart_a.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertEqual(restart_b.redirect_uri, OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK)


class ConsentRestartExactCallbackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_restart_uses_pending_authorization_callback_not_a_recomputed_one(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")

            result = service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], ["profile.read"])
            restart = storage.get_consent_restart(result["restart_id"])

            self.assertEqual(restart.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertNotEqual(restart.redirect_uri, OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK)

    def test_restart_rejected_when_registered_callback_no_longer_matches_pending(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            authorize_result = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")

            with storage._lock, storage._conn:
                storage._conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE clients SET redirect_uri = ? WHERE client_id = ?",
                    ("http://127.0.0.1:9999/moved", CLIENT_ID),
                )

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], ["profile.read"])
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_authorization")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Focused tests for restart-ticket expiry cleanup and consent denial history."""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc import resume
from oauthsvc.cli import main
from oauthsvc.service import OAuthService
from oauthsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_EMAIL,
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start: float = 1_000.0):
        self._now = start

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self._now

    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self._now += seconds


def _seed_restart(storage, restart_id, expires_at, login_id="login-1", client_id=CLIENT_ID,
                   callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, approved_scopes=None):
    storage.create_pending_authorization(
        login_id, client_id, callback, "state-1", source="native", created_at=0.0
    )
    browser_handle = f"handle-{restart_id}"
    locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(browser_handle, client_id)
    storage.create_consent_restart(
        restart_id=restart_id,
        login_id=login_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        redirect_uri=callback,
        approved_scopes=approved_scopes or ["profile.read"],
        state="state-1",
        browser_handle=browser_handle,
        locator=locator,
        created_at=0.0,
        expires_at=expires_at,
    )


@contextlib.contextmanager
def temp_db_path():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
    os.close(fd)
    os.remove(path)
    try:
        yield path
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)


def _run_cli(argv):
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        code = main(argv)
    return code, buf.getvalue()


class CleanupBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ticket_exactly_at_expiry_boundary_is_not_removed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-boundary", expires_at=clock())
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(removed, 0)
            self.assertIsNotNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-boundary"))

    def test_ticket_past_expiry_is_removed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 0.001)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)
            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))

    def test_cleanup_only_removes_expired_leaving_active_ticket_intact(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 10, login_id="login-a")
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-active", expires_at=clock() + 10, login_id="login-b")
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)
            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))
            self.assertIsNotNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-active"))


class RepeatedCleanupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_repeated_cleanup_in_same_process_is_idempotent(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            first = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            second = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            third = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()

            self.assertEqual(first, 1)
            self.assertEqual(second, 0)
            self.assertEqual(third, 0)


class CleanupAcrossProcessRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_idempotent_after_reopening_storage(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            storage = Storage(path)
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)
            first = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            storage.close()

            self.assertEqual(first, 1)

            # Simulate a process restart: brand-new Storage handle, same file.
            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                reopened_service = OAuthService(reopened, signing_key="k", clock=clock)
                second = reopened_service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
                self.assertEqual(second, 0)
                self.assertIsNone(reopened.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))
            finally:
                reopened.close()


class CleanupPreservesOtherRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_preserves_active_pending_authorization_and_used_code(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            # An active (uncompleted) pending authorization, unrelated to the expired ticket.
            active_login = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-active")["login_id"]

            # A fully redeemed (used) authorization code.
            code_login = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-code")["login_id"]
            location = service.complete_login(code_login, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]
            service.exchange_token(CLIENT_ID, code)

            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 5, login_id="restart-login")

            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)

            active_pending = storage.get_pending_authorization(active_login)
            self.assertIsNotNone(active_pending)
            self.assertFalse(active_pending.completed)

            used_code = storage.get_code(code)
            self.assertIsNotNone(used_code)
            self.assertTrue(used_code.used)

            self.assertIsNone(storage.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))


class ConsentDenialHistoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _authorize_and_restart(self, service, scopes):
        login_id = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")["login_id"]
        return service.create_consent_restart(login_id, scopes)["restart_id"]

    def test_denied_decision_records_denial_history_and_issues_no_code(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id = self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            location = service.complete_consent_restart(
                restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", []
            )

            query = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)
            self.assertEqual(query["error"], ["access_denied"])
            self.assertNotIn("code", query)

            denials = storage.list_recent_consent_denials(limit=10)
            self.assertEqual(len(denials), 1)
            self.assertEqual(denials[0].restart_id, restart_id)
            self.assertEqual(denials[0].client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(denials[0].account_id, ACCOUNT_ID)

    def test_approved_decision_does_not_record_denial(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id = self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            service.complete_consent_restart(
                restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "approved", ["profile.read"]
            )

            self.assertEqual(storage.list_recent_consent_denials(limit=10), [])

    def test_status_reports_bounded_recent_denials_most_recent_first(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            restart_ids = [self._authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"]) for _ in range(3)]
            for restart_id in restart_ids:
                service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

            status = service.consent_restart_status(limit=2)

            self.assertEqual(len(status["recent_denials"]), 2)
            reported_ids = [entry["restart_id"] for entry in status["recent_denials"]]
            self.assertEqual(reported_ids, list(reversed(restart_ids))[:2])


class CliCleanupAndStatusTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cleanup_consent_restarts_parser_shape(self):
        from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser

        args = build_parser().parse_args(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", "state.db"])
        self.assertEqual(args.command, "cleanup-consent-restarts")
        self.assertEqual(args.database, "state.db")

    def test_consent_restart_status_parser_shape_with_default_limit(self):
        from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser

        args = build_parser().parse_args(["consent-restart-status", "--database", "state.db"])
        self.assertEqual(args.command, "consent-restart-status")
        self.assertEqual(args.database, "state.db")
        self.assertEqual(args.limit, 10)

    def test_consent_restart_status_rejects_non_positive_limit(self):
        from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser

        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            build_parser().parse_args(
                ["consent-restart-status", "--database", "state.db", "--limit", "0"]
            )

    def test_cli_cleanup_end_to_end_is_idempotent_across_invocations(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            exit_code, _ = _run_cli(
                ["create-account", ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_EMAIL, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "--database", path]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            exit_code, _ = _run_cli(
                ["register-client", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "--database", path]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)

            storage = Storage(path)
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=-1.0)
            storage.close()

            exit_code, out = _run_cli(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", path])
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), {"removed": 1})

            # A second CLI invocation is a brand-new process/Storage handle.
            exit_code, out = _run_cli(["cleanup-consent-restarts", "--database", path])
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), {"removed": 0})

    def test_cli_status_reports_bounded_counts_and_denials(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            _run_cli(["create-account", ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_EMAIL, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "--database", path])
            _run_cli(["register-client", CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "--database", path])

            storage = Storage(path)
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-active", expires_at=1e18, login_id="login-active")
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-expired", expires_at=-1.0, login_id="login-expired")
            for i in range(3):
                storage.record_consent_denial(f"restart-denied-{i}", CLIENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, "state-1", float(i))
            storage.close()

            exit_code, out = _run_cli(
                ["consent-restart-status", "--database", path, "--limit", "2"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(exit_code, 0)
            status = json.loads(out)
            self.assertEqual(status["active_consent_restarts"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(status["expired_consent_restarts"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(status["recent_denials"]), 2)


class SeparateProcessReadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_second_storage_handle_sees_cleanup_and_denial_results(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            process_a = Storage(path)
            try:
                seed(process_a)
                clock = FakeClock()
                service_a = OAuthService(process_a, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

                login_id = service_a.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state-1")["login_id"]
                restart_id = service_a.create_consent_restart(login_id, ["profile.read"])["restart_id"]
                service_a.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

                _seed_restart(process_a, "restart-expired", expires_at=clock() - 1, login_id="other-login")
                removed = service_a.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
                self.assertEqual(removed, 1)
            finally:
                process_a.close()

            process_b = Storage(path)

                self.assertIsNone(process_b.get_consent_restart("restart-expired"))

                self.assertEqual(denials[0].account_id, ACCOUNT_ID)
            finally:

"""Focused tests for restart audit summaries, bounded diagnostics, and redaction."""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc import resume
from oauthsvc.cli import build_parser, main
from oauthsvc.service import DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS, OAuthService
from oauthsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_EMAIL,
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start: float = 1_000.0):
        self._now = start

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self._now

    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self._now += seconds


def _seed_restart(
    storage,
    restart_id,
    expires_at,
    login_id="login-1",
    client_id=CLIENT_ID,
    callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    approved_scopes=None,
    state="state-1",
):
    storage.create_pending_authorization(
        login_id, client_id, callback, state, source="native", created_at=0.0
    )
    browser_handle = f"handle-{restart_id}"
    locator = resume.encode_continuation_locator(browser_handle, client_id)
    storage.create_consent_restart(
        restart_id=restart_id,
        login_id=login_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        redirect_uri=callback,
        approved_scopes=approved_scopes or ["profile.read"],
        state=state,
        browser_handle=browser_handle,
        locator=locator,
        created_at=0.0,
        expires_at=expires_at,
    )
    return browser_handle, locator


@contextlib.contextmanager
def temp_db_path():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
    os.close(fd)
    os.remove(path)
    try:
        yield path
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)


def _run_cli(argv):
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        code = main(argv)
    return code, buf.getvalue()


def _authorize_and_restart(service, scopes, state="state-1"):
    login_id = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, state)["login_id"]
    return service.create_consent_restart(login_id, scopes)["restart_id"], login_id


class AuditSummaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_audit_reports_unknown_restart_id_as_not_found(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            audit = service.consent_restart_audit("nonexistent-restart")

            self.assertEqual(audit["restart_id"], "nonexistent-restart")
            self.assertFalse(audit["found"])
            self.assertIsNone(audit["expired"])
            self.assertIsNone(audit["client_id"])
            self.assertIsNone(audit["redirect_uri"])
            self.assertIsNone(audit["approved_scopes"])
            self.assertIsNone(audit["state"])
            self.assertEqual(audit["denial_count"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denials"], [])

    def test_audit_reports_active_restart_fields(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)
            restart_id, _login_id = _authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read", "email.read"])

            audit = service.consent_restart_audit(restart_id)

            self.assertTrue(audit["found"])
            self.assertFalse(audit["expired"])
            self.assertEqual(audit["client_id"], CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(audit["redirect_uri"], CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertEqual(audit["approved_scopes"], ["profile.read", "email.read"])
            self.assertEqual(audit["state"], "state-1")
            self.assertEqual(audit["denial_count"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denials"], [])

    def test_audit_reports_expired_flag_once_past_expiry(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            _seed_restart(storage, "restart-1", expires_at=clock() + 5)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)

            self.assertFalse(service.consent_restart_audit("restart-1")["expired"])

            clock.advance(10)
            audit = service.consent_restart_audit("restart-1")
            self.assertTrue(audit["found"])
            self.assertTrue(audit["expired"])

    def test_audit_records_denial_history_for_its_own_restart(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id, _login_id = _authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

            audit = service.consent_restart_audit(restart_id)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denial_count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(audit["denials"]), 1)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denials"][0]["client_id"], CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denials"][0]["account_id"], ACCOUNT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denials"][0]["state"], "state-1")

    def test_audit_denial_history_survives_cleanup_of_the_restart_row(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", clock=clock)
            restart_id, _login_id = _authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])
            service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

            clock.advance(DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS + 1)
            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            self.assertEqual(removed, 1)

            audit = service.consent_restart_audit(restart_id)
            self.assertFalse(audit["found"])
            self.assertIsNone(audit["expired"])
            self.assertEqual(audit["denial_count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(audit["denials"]), 1)

    def test_audit_denials_bounded_by_limit_but_count_reflects_total(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id, _login_id = _authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"])

            for _ in range(3):
                service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

            audit = service.consent_restart_audit(restart_id, limit=2)
            self.assertEqual(audit["denial_count"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(len(audit["denials"]), 2)

"""Focused tests for authorize/callback binding, over the real loopback HTTP surface."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc.service import OAuthError

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class AuthorizeHttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_authorize_returns_login_id_and_resume_reference(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize",
                    {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state": "state-1"},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 201)
                self.assertEqual(set(body.keys()), {"login_id", "resume_reference"})
                self.assertIsInstance(body["login_id"], str)
                self.assertEqual(
                    set(body["resume_reference"].keys()), {"kind", "client_id", "value"}
                )
                self.assertEqual(body["resume_reference"]["client_id"], CLIENT_ID)

    def test_authorize_rejects_unregistered_client(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize",
                    {"client_id": "no-such-client", "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state": "s"},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "unregistered_callback"})

    def test_authorize_rejects_mismatched_callback(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize",
                    {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": "http://evil.example/cb", "state": "s"},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "unregistered_callback"})

    def test_authorize_rejects_malformed_request(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_authorize_rejects_non_string_field(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/authorize",
                    {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state": 104},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_unknown_path_returns_not_found(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post("/oauth/consent/restarts/some-id/complete/extra", {})
                self.assertEqual(status, 404)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "not_found"})


class LoginCompleteHttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _authorize(self, server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, state="state-1"):
        status, body = server.post(
            "/oauth/authorize", {"client_id": client_id, "redirect_uri": callback, "state": state}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        return body["login_id"]

    def test_login_complete_redirects_to_registered_callback_with_state_preserved(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server, state="consent-state-104")

                status, body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                self.assertEqual(set(body.keys()), {"location"})
                parts = urlsplit(body["location"])
                query = parse_qs(parts.query)
                self.assertTrue(body["location"].startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))
                self.assertEqual(query["state"], ["consent-state-104"])
                self.assertEqual(len(query["code"]), 1)

    def test_login_complete_rejects_unknown_login_id(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": "does-not-exist", "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_login"})

    def test_login_complete_rejects_wrong_password(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": "wrong"},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_credentials"})

    def test_login_complete_rejects_replayed_login(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_id = self._authorize(server)
                first_status, _ = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                self.assertEqual(first_status, 200)

                status, body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_id, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_authorization"})

    def test_login_complete_rejects_malformed_request(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post("/login/complete", {"login_id": "x"})
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_two_clients_get_distinct_callbacks(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                login_a = self._authorize(server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK)
                login_b = self._authorize(
                    server, client_id=OTHER_CLIENT_ID, callback=OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK
                )

                _, body_a = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_a, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                _, body_b = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {"login_id": login_b, "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )

                self.assertTrue(body_a["location"].startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))
                self.assertTrue(body_b["location"].startswith(OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK))


class ImportLegacyLoginTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_import_returns_exactly_client_id_login_id_and_resume_reference(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            from oauthsvc.service import OAuthService

            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="unused")

            # The opaque handle text references another client, but ownership
            # must follow the importing client, not the handle's contents.
            result = service.import_legacy_login(
                CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "consent-ledger:consent-mobile-b", "consent-state-104"
            )

            self.assertEqual(set(result.keys()), {"client_id", "login_id", "resume_reference"})
            self.assertEqual(result["client_id"], CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertIsInstance(result["login_id"], str)
            resume_reference = result["resume_reference"]
            self.assertEqual(set(resume_reference.keys()), {"kind", "client_id", "value"})
            self.assertEqual(resume_reference["client_id"], CLIENT_ID)

    def test_import_rejects_unregistered_callback(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            from oauthsvc.service import OAuthService

            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="unused")
            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.import_legacy_login(CLIENT_ID, "http://evil.example/cb", "handle", "state")
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "unregistered_callback")

    def test_imported_login_completes_through_owning_client_callback(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            from oauthsvc.service import OAuthService

            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="unused")
            imported = service.import_legacy_login(
                CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, "consent-ledger:consent-mobile-b", "consent-state-104"
            )

            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/login/complete",
                    {
                        "login_id": imported["login_id"],
                        "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID,
                        "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
                    },
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                self.assertTrue(body["location"].startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

9	_PBKDF2_ALGORITHM = "sha256"

13	def hash_password(password: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
14	    """Return a (salt, digest) pair for a new password."""
15	
16	    salt = secrets.token_hex(16)
17	    digest = _derive(password, salt)
18	    return salt, digest

21	def verify_password(password: str, salt: str, expected_digest: str) -> bool:
22	    """Return whether `password` matches the stored salt/digest pair."""
23	
24	    candidate = _derive(password, salt)
25	    return hmac.compare_digest(candidate, expected_digest)
26	
27	
28	def _derive(password: str, salt: str) -> str:
29	    return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
30	        _PBKDF2_ALGORITHM,
31	        password.encode("utf-8"),
32	        bytes.fromhex(salt),
33	        _PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,
34	    ).hex()

38	    return secrets.token_urlsafe(24)

"""Focused tests for browser-consent restart completion."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc.service import OAuthError, OAuthService

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
    temp_storage,
)


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start: float = 1_000.0):
        self._now = start

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self._now

    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self._now += seconds


class ServiceLevelConsentConfirmationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _make_restart(self, service, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, scopes=None, state="state-1"):
        scopes = scopes if scopes is not None else ["profile.read", "devices.list"]
        authorize_result = service.authorize(client_id, callback, state)
        restart = service.create_consent_restart(authorize_result["login_id"], scopes)
        return restart["restart_id"]

    def test_completion_issues_code_bound_to_approved_scopes_and_preserves_client_and_callback(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id = self._make_restart(service)

            location = service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)

            self.assertTrue(location.startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))
            code = parse_qs(urlsplit(location).query)["code"][0]
            stored = storage.get_code(code)
            self.assertEqual(stored.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(stored.redirect_uri, CLIENT_CALLBACK)
            self.assertEqual(sorted(stored.scopes), ["devices.list", "profile.read"])

    def test_expired_restart_ticket_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", code_ttl_seconds=5, clock=clock)
            restart_id = self._make_restart(service)

            clock.advance(5.001)

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "expired_restart")

    def test_unknown_restart_id_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.complete_consent_restart("does-not-exist", ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_restart")

    def test_wrong_password_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_id = self._make_restart(service)

            with self.assertRaises(OAuthError) as ctx:
                service.complete_consent_restart(restart_id, ACCOUNT_ID, "wrong-password")
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error, "invalid_credentials")

    def test_client_and_callback_preserved_per_ticket_even_when_scopes_differ(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_a = self._make_restart(
                service, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, scopes=["profile.read", "devices.list"]
            )
            restart_b = self._make_restart(
                service,
                client_id=OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
                callback=OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK,
                scopes=["profile.read"],
            )

            location_a = service.complete_consent_restart(restart_a, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)
            location_b = service.complete_consent_restart(restart_b, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD)

            self.assertTrue(location_a.startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))
            self.assertTrue(location_b.startswith(OTHER_CLIENT_CALLBACK))
            code_a = parse_qs(urlsplit(location_a).query)["code"][0]
            code_b = parse_qs(urlsplit(location_b).query)["code"][0]
            self.assertEqual(storage.get_code(code_a).client_id, CLIENT_ID)
            self.assertEqual(storage.get_code(code_b).client_id, OTHER_CLIENT_ID)


class HttpConsentConfirmationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _make_restart(self, server, client_id=CLIENT_ID, callback=CLIENT_CALLBACK, scopes=None, state="state-1"):
        scopes = scopes if scopes is not None else ["profile.read", "devices.list"]
        status, authorize_body = server.post(
            "/oauth/authorize", {"client_id": client_id, "redirect_uri": callback, "state": state}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, restart_body = server.post(
            "/oauth/consent/restarts",
            {"login_id": authorize_body["login_id"], "approved_scopes": scopes},
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        return restart_body["restart_id"]

    def test_completion_over_http_returns_exactly_location(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)

                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                self.assertEqual(set(body.keys()), {"location"})
                self.assertTrue(body["location"].startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))
                query = parse_qs(urlsplit(body["location"]).query)
                self.assertEqual(len(query["code"]), 1)

    def test_expired_restart_over_http(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            clock = FakeClock()
            with RunningServer(storage, code_ttl_seconds=1, clock=clock) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)

                clock.advance(1.5)

                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "expired_restart"})

    def test_unknown_restart_id_over_http(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                status, body = server.post(
                    "/oauth/consent/restarts/does-not-exist/complete",
                    {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_restart"})

    def test_wrong_password_over_http(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)

                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": "wrong-password"},
                )

                self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_credentials"})


class ConsentConfirmationMalformedRequestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _make_restart(self, server):
        status, authorize_body = server.post(
            "/oauth/authorize", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "redirect_uri": CLIENT_CALLBACK, "state": "state-1"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, restart_body = server.post(
            "/oauth/consent/restarts",
            {"login_id": authorize_body["login_id"], "approved_scopes": ["profile.read", "devices.list"]},
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        return restart_body["restart_id"]

    def test_missing_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)
                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete", {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID}
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_extra_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)
                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "extra": "field"},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_callback_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)
                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {
                        "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID,
                        "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
                        "callback": "http://evil.example/cb",
                    },
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_redirect_uri_field_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)
                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {
                        "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID,
                        "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
                        "redirect_uri": "http://evil.example/cb",
                    },
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_non_string_account_id_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)
                status, body = server.post(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                    {"account_id": 104, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

    def test_request_body_that_is_not_an_object_is_malformed(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            with RunningServer(storage) as server:
                restart_id = self._make_restart(server)
                status, body = server.post_raw(
                    f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete", b"[1, 2, 3]"
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})

class AuditScopingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_audit_for_one_restart_does_not_leak_another_restarts_denial(self):
        with temp_storage() as storage:
            seed(storage)
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k")
            restart_a, _ = _authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"], state="state-a")
            restart_b, _ = _authorize_and_restart(service, ["profile.read"], state="state-b")

            service.complete_consent_restart(restart_a, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])
            service.complete_consent_restart(restart_b, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])
            service.complete_consent_restart(restart_b, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, "denied", [])

            audit_a = service.consent_restart_audit(restart_a)
            audit_b = service.consent_restart_audit(restart_b)

            self.assertEqual(audit_a["denial_count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(audit_b["denial_count"], 2)
            self.assertNotIn(restart_b, json.dumps(audit_a))
            self.assertNotIn(restart_a, json.dumps(audit_b))

            storage.record_consent_denial("restart-y", CLIENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, "state-1", 2.0)
            storage.record_consent_denial("restart-y", CLIENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, "state-1", 3.0)

            self.assertEqual(storage.count_consent_denials_for_restart("restart-x"), 1)
            self.assertEqual(storage.count_consent_denials_for_restart("restart-y"), 2)
            self.assertEqual(len(storage.list_consent_denials_for_restart("restart-x", limit=10)), 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(storage.list_consent_denials_for_restart("restart-y", limit=10)), 2)

"""Separate-process integration tests for browser-consent restart completion.

Each test seeds a restart ticket, closes its Storage handle, then reopens the
same database file behind a brand-new server -- simulating the ticket
surviving an actual process restart -- before invoking
POST /oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete over the real loopback
HTTP surface.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from oauthsvc import resume
from oauthsvc.service import OAuthService
from oauthsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import (
    ACCOUNT_ID,
    ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
    CLIENT_CALLBACK,
    CLIENT_ID,
    OTHER_CLIENT_ID,
    RunningServer,
    seed,
)


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start: float = 1_000.0):
        self._now = start

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self._now

    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self._now += seconds


@contextlib.contextmanager
def temp_db_path():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
    os.close(fd)
    os.remove(path)
    try:
        yield path
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)


def _create_restart_and_close(path, clock=None, code_ttl_seconds=120, scopes=None, state="state-1"):
    """Seed an account/client/restart ticket, then close storage -- the end of
    the process that created it. Returns (restart_id, stored_locator)."""
    scopes = scopes if scopes is not None else ["profile.read", "devices.list"]
    storage = Storage(path)
    try:
        seed(storage)
        kwargs = {} if clock is None else {"clock": clock}
        service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="k", code_ttl_seconds=code_ttl_seconds, **kwargs)
        login_id = service.authorize(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_CALLBACK, state)["login_id"]
        restart_id = service.create_consent_restart(login_id, scopes)["restart_id"]
        restart = storage.get_consent_restart(restart_id)
        return restart_id, restart.locator
    finally:
        storage.close()


class RestartCompletionAfterProcessRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_completion_after_reopen_exchanges_for_a_token_with_expected_claims(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            restart_id, _locator = _create_restart_and_close(
                path, scopes=["profile.read", "devices.list"]
            )

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened) as server:
                    status, body = server.post(
                        f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                        {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                    self.assertEqual(set(body.keys()), {"location"})
                    self.assertTrue(body["location"].startswith(CLIENT_CALLBACK))

                    code = parse_qs(urlsplit(body["location"]).query)["code"][0]
                    stored = reopened.get_code(code)
                    self.assertEqual(stored.client_id, CLIENT_ID)
                    self.assertEqual(sorted(stored.scopes), ["devices.list", "profile.read"])
                    self.assertGreater(stored.expires_at, 0)
                    self.assertFalse(stored.used)

                    status, token_body = server.post(
                        "/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code}
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                    self.assertEqual(set(token_body.keys()), {"access_token", "client_id", "account_id"})
                    self.assertEqual(token_body["account_id"], ACCOUNT_ID)
                    self.assertEqual(token_body["client_id"], CLIENT_ID)

                    self.assertTrue(reopened.get_code(code).used)
            finally:
                reopened.close()


class RestartCompletionRejectionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_wrong_password_after_reopen_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            restart_id, _locator = _create_restart_and_close(path)

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened) as server:
                    status, body = server.post(
                        f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                        {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": "wrong-password"},
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                    self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_credentials"})
            finally:
                reopened.close()

    def test_substituted_callback_field_after_reopen_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            restart_id, _locator = _create_restart_and_close(path)

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened) as server:
                    status, body = server.post(
                        f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                        {
                            "account_id": ACCOUNT_ID,
                            "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD,
                            "callback": "http://attacker.example/steal",
                        },
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                    self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "malformed_request"})
            finally:
                reopened.close()

    def test_wrong_client_exchange_after_reopen_is_rejected(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            restart_id, _locator = _create_restart_and_close(path)

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened) as server:
                    status, body = server.post(
                        f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                        {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                    code = parse_qs(urlsplit(body["location"]).query)["code"][0]

                    status, body = server.post(
                        "/oauth/token", {"client_id": OTHER_CLIENT_ID, "code": code}
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                    self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "wrong_client"})
            finally:
                reopened.close()

    def test_expired_authorization_code_after_reopen_cannot_be_exchanged(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            clock = FakeClock()
            restart_id, _locator = _create_restart_and_close(path, clock=clock, code_ttl_seconds=5)

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened, code_ttl_seconds=5, clock=clock) as server:
                    status, body = server.post(
                        f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                        {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                    code = parse_qs(urlsplit(body["location"]).query)["code"][0]

                    clock.advance(5.001)

                    status, body = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                    self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                    self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_code"})
            finally:
                reopened.close()

    def test_replayed_code_after_reopen_cannot_be_exchanged_twice(self):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            restart_id, _locator = _create_restart_and_close(path)

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened) as server:
                    status, body = server.post(
                        f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                        {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(status, 200)
                    code = parse_qs(urlsplit(body["location"]).query)["code"][0]

                    status, _ = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                    self.assertEqual(status, 200)

                    status, body = server.post("/oauth/token", {"client_id": CLIENT_ID, "code": code})
                    self.assertEqual(status, 403)
                    self.assertEqual(body, {"error": "invalid_code"})
            finally:
                reopened.close()


class RecoverClientAndCallbackUsageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_completion_calls_recover_client_and_callback_once_with_stored_locator_and_authoritative_client(
        self,
    ):
        with temp_db_path() as path:
            restart_id, locator = _create_restart_and_close(path)

            reopened = Storage(path)
            try:
                with RunningServer(reopened) as server:
                    with patch.object(
                        resume, "recover_client_and_callback", wraps=resume.recover_client_and_callback
                    ) as mock_recover:
                        status, _body = server.post(
                            f"/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete",
                            {"account_id": ACCOUNT_ID, "password": ACCOUNT_PASSWORD},
                        )
                        self.assertEqual(status, 200)

                    mock_recover.assert_called_once()
                    call_args = mock_recover.call_args.args
                    self.assertEqual(call_args[0], locator)
                    # CLIENT_ID ("client-a") is the authoritative client owned by
                    # the pending authorization behind this restart ticket.
                    self.assertEqual(call_args[1], CLIENT_ID)
            finally:
                reopened.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Summary of what changed:

**Production code:**
- `oauthsvc/service.py::complete_consent_restart` — rewritten to accept exactly `(restart_id, account_id, password)`. It loads the restart ticket, loads the pending authorization by `restart.login_id`, calls `resume.recover_client_and_callback(restart.locator, pending.client_id, callback_for_client)`, authenticates the account, then issues a single-use code bound to the resolved client/callback with `restart.approved_scopes` and `restart.state`. The old `decision`/`confirmed_scopes`/deny path is gone.
- `oauthsvc/server.py` — the `/oauth/consent/restarts/{restart_id}/complete` route validators now accept exactly `{account_id, password}`; any `callback`/`redirect_uri` (or other extra) field is rejected as `malformed_request` by the existing exact-key-match check. Removed the now-unused `_is_decision` helper.
- `oauthsvc/resume.py` untouched, as required.

**Tests:**
- Rewrote `test_consent_confirmation.py`, and fixed the affected classes in `test_restart_cleanup.py` and `test_restart_audit.py`, to drop the removed decision/confirmed_scopes contract — denial-history tests now seed `consent_denials` directly via `storage.record_consent_denial` (that table/audit path is otherwise untouched and still fully functional for reads).
- Added `oauthsvc/tests/test_restart_completion_integration.py`: closes and reopens the SQLite file to simulate a process restart, completes the ticket over real loopback HTTP, exchanges the code via `/oauth/token`, and asserts account/client/scopes/expiry/single-use. Covers rejections for wrong password, a substituted `callback` field, wrong-client exchange, expired code, and replay. A dedicated test wraps `oauthsvc.resume.recover_client_and_callback` with `patch.object(..., wraps=...)` and asserts it's called exactly once with the restart's stored locator and the authoritative `CLIENT_ID`.

**Verification:** focused module — 7/7 pass; full suite via `unittest discover -q` — 121/121 pass.

    def record_consent_restart_completion(self, restart_id: str, account_id: str, code: str) -> None:
        """Idempotently record a completion: the first call wins the stored
        account/code, later calls for the same ticket only bump the counter."""
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE consent_restarts"
                " SET account_id = COALESCE(account_id, ?),"
                "     completed_code = COALESCE(completed_code, ?),"
                "     completion_count = completion_count + 1"
                " WHERE restart_id = ?",
                (account_id, code, restart_id),
            )

    def count_completed_consent_restarts(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM consent_restarts WHERE completion_count > 0"
            ).fetchone()
        return row["n"]

    def count_duplicate_completion_attempts(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(MAX(completion_count - 1, 0)), 0) AS n FROM consent_restarts"
            ).fetchone()
        return row["n"]

"""Command-line entry point: python -m oauthsvc.cli ..."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .server import make_server
from .service import DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS, OAuthError, OAuthService
from .storage import Storage


def _positive_int(raw: str) -> int:
    try:
        value = int(raw)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{raw!r} is not an integer") from None
    if value <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be a positive integer")
    return value


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m oauthsvc.cli")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create_account = sub.add_parser("create-account")
    create_account.add_argument("account_id")
    create_account.add_argument("email")
    create_account.add_argument("password")
    create_account.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    register_client = sub.add_parser("register-client")
    register_client.add_argument("client_id")
    register_client.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    register_client.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    import_legacy_login = sub.add_parser("import-legacy-login")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("client_id")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("redirect_uri")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("legacy_handle")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("state")
    import_legacy_login.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    serve = sub.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--signing-key", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--code-ttl-seconds", type=_positive_int, default=DEFAULT_CODE_TTL_SECONDS)

    cleanup_consent_restarts = sub.add_parser("cleanup-consent-restarts")
    cleanup_consent_restarts.add_argument("--database", required=True)

    consent_restart_status = sub.add_parser("consent-restart-status")
    consent_restart_status.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    consent_restart_status.add_argument("--limit", type=_positive_int, default=10)

    consent_restart_audit = sub.add_parser("consent-restart-audit")
    consent_restart_audit.add_argument("restart_id")
    consent_restart_audit.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    consent_restart_audit.add_argument("--limit", type=_positive_int, default=10)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    storage = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        if args.command == "create-account":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.create_account(args.account_id, args.email, args.password)
            return 0

        if args.command == "register-client":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            service.register_client(args.client_id, args.redirect_uri)
            return 0

        if args.command == "import-legacy-login":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            result = service.import_legacy_login(
                args.client_id, args.redirect_uri, args.legacy_handle, args.state
            )
            print(json.dumps(result))
            return 0

        if args.command == "cleanup-consent-restarts":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            removed = service.cleanup_expired_consent_restarts()
            print(json.dumps({"removed": removed}))
            return 0

        if args.command == "consent-restart-status":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            status = service.consent_restart_status(limit=args.limit)
            print(json.dumps(status))
            return 0

        if args.command == "consent-restart-audit":
            service = OAuthService(storage, signing_key="")
            audit = service.consent_restart_audit(args.restart_id, limit=args.limit)
            print(json.dumps(audit, sort_keys=True))
            return 0

        if args.command == "serve":
            server = make_server(
                storage, args.signing_key, code_ttl_seconds=args.code_ttl_seconds
            )
            host, port = server.server_address[:2]
            print(f"Listening on http://{host}:{port}")
            try:
                server.serve_forever()
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                server.shutdown()
                server.server_close()
            return 0

        raise AssertionError(f"unhandled command {args.command!r}")
    except OAuthError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc.error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        if args.command != "serve":
            storage.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
